label: Max OSC Localhost
requirements: Node.js 24.x on the same host as Max/MSP
Max patch listening on localhost UDP

inboundOsc: /mn42/cmd with JSON payloads for the live slot-value lane

expectedTelemetry: Max receives slot and envelope packets on localhost
The bridge console shows recent route traces for OSC telemetry fan-out
manualValidationChecklist: Receive /mn42/slots in Max and confirm 42 integers arrive
Send one /mn42/cmd payload back to the bridge and confirm it reaches the serial lane
Inspect Advanced mode for raw serial and route trace parity
